shortDescription: Manipulate entries in the key/value store of a consul cluster

options.name: cas
options.description: Used when acquiring a lock with a session. If the C(cas) is C(0), then Consul will only put the key if it does not already exist. If the C(cas) value is non-zero, then the key is only set if the index matches the ModifyIndex of that key.

options.name: dc
options.description: The datacenter that this agent will communicate with. By default the datacenter of the host is used.

options.name: flags
options.description: Opaque positive integer value that can be passed when setting a value.

options.name: key
options.description: The key at which the value should be stored.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: recurse
options.description: If the key represents a prefix, each entry with the prefix can be retrieved by setting this to C(yes).

options.name: retrieve
options.description: If the I(state) is C(present) and I(value) is set, perform a read after setting the value and return this value.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: session
options.description: The session that should be used to acquire or release a lock associated with a key/value pair.

options.name: state
options.description: The action to take with the supplied key and value. If the state is 'present' and `value` is set, the key contents will be set to the value supplied and `changed` will be set to `true` only if the value was different to the current contents. If the state is 'present' and `value` is not set, the existing value associated to the key will be returned. The state 'absent' will remove the key/value pair, again 'changed' will be set to true only if the key actually existed prior to the removal. An atte

options.name: token
options.description: The token key identifying an ACL rule set that controls access to the key value pair

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the tls certificate of the consul agent.

options.name: value
options.description: The value should be associated with the given key, required if C(state) is C(present).
